en.t: The Avars and Sassanids besiege Constantinople, held by Byzantine troops under Patrician Bonus
en.s: The siege of Constantinople in 626 by the Sassanid Persians and Avars, aided by large numbers of allied Slavs, ended in a strategic victory for the Byzantines. The failure of the siege saved the empire from collapse, and, combined with other victories achieved by Emperor Heraclius (r. 610–641) the previous year and in 627, enabled Byzantium to regain its territories and end the destructive Roman–Persian Wars by enforcing a treaty with borders status quo c.

zh.t: 阿瓦尔人和萨珊波斯人围攻君士坦丁堡
zh.s: 626年，萨珊波斯人与阿瓦尔人围攻君士坦丁堡，并得到大批斯拉夫盟军支援。博努斯率领的拜占庭守军最终取得战略性胜利。围城失败使帝国免于崩溃；再加上皇帝希拉克略前一年和627年取得的其他胜利，拜占庭得以收复领土，并通过恢复原有边界的条约结束旷日持久的罗马—波斯战争。

en.t: Romanos IV Diogenes is blinded at Kotyaion
en.s: On June 29, 1072, former Byzantine emperor Romanos IV Diogenes was blinded at Kotyaion, now Kütahya in Turkey.

zh.t: 罗曼努斯四世被刺瞎双眼
zh.s: 1072年6月29日，拜占庭前皇帝罗曼努斯四世·第欧根尼在科提安（今土耳其屈塔希亚）被刺瞎双眼。

en.s: The Battle of Inab, also called Battle of Ard al-Hâtim or Fons Muratus, was fought on 29 June 1149, during the Second Crusade. The Zengid army of the atabeg Nur al-Din Zengi destroyed the combined army of Prince Raymond of Antioch and the Assassins of Ali ibn-Wafa. The prince was killed, and the Principality of Antioch was subsequently pillaged and reduced in size as its eastern border was pushed west.

zh.s: 第二次十字军东征期间，1149年6月29日爆发伊纳卜之战，又称阿尔哈蒂姆之战或穆拉图斯泉之战。努尔丁·赞吉的赞吉军队击溃了安条克亲王雷蒙德与阿里·伊本·瓦法领导的阿萨辛派联军。雷蒙德阵亡，安条克公国随后遭到劫掠，领土缩小，东部边界被迫西移。

en.s: One of the largest earthquakes to hit Syria occurred early in the morning of 29 June 1170. It formed part of a sequence of large earthquakes that propagated southwards along the Dead Sea Transform, starting with the 1138 Aleppo earthquake, continuing with the 1157 Hama, 1170 and 1202 Syria events. The estimated magnitude is 7.7 on the moment magnitude scale, with the maximum intensity of X (Extreme) on the Mercalli intensity scale.

zh.s: 1170年6月29日清晨，叙利亚发生了一场规模最大的地震之一。这场地震属于一系列沿死海转换断层向南传播的大地震：序列始于1138年阿勒颇地震，之后包括1157年哈马、1170年和1202年的叙利亚地震。估计震级为矩震级7.7级，麦加利烈度最高达X级（极震）。

en.t: Sverre is crowned King of Norway in Bergen
en.s: On June 29, 1194, Sverre was crowned King of Norway in Bergen.

zh.s: 1194年6月29日，斯韦雷在卑尔根加冕为挪威国王。

en.s: During the Reconquista, the siege of Córdoba (Spanish: Conquista de Córdoba, Conquest of Córdoba) was a successful investment by the forces of Ferdinand III, king of Castile and León, marking the end of the Islamic rule over the city that had begun in 711.

zh.s: 1236年6月29日，斐迪南三世率领的卡斯蒂利亚军队在围城后夺取西班牙科尔多瓦，结束了这座城市长期由穆斯林政权统治的时期。

en.s: The Battle of the River Dee was a battle fought on 29 June 1308 during the Scottish Wars of Independence near Buittle, on the banks of the River Dee, Galloway, Scotland. Sir Edward de Brus having been left in command in Galloway, Edward led a campaign in Galloway and Douglasdale. Edward had defeated John St John during the Battle of Kirroughtree. He then turned his attention to the stronghold of Buittle Castle and the Balliol lands. On 29 June 1308, the forces of Edward met a force commanded by Dungal MacDouall of Galloway and Sir Ingram de Umfraville and Sir Aymer de St John, on the banks of the River Dee at a ford on the River.

zh.s: 迪河之战于1308年6月29日在苏格兰加洛韦的布特尔附近、迪河岸边爆发，是苏格兰独立战争的一场战斗。爱德华·德·布鲁斯受命留守加洛韦后，率军在加洛韦和道格拉斯代尔作战，并已在基罗特里之战中击败约翰·圣约翰。随后，他将目标转向布特尔城堡和巴利奥尔家族的领地。6月29日，爱德华的部队在迪河的一处浅滩与邓加尔·麦克道尔、英格拉姆·德·昂弗拉维尔爵士和艾默·德·圣约翰爵士率领的部队相遇。

en.s: The Battle of Anghiari was fought on 29 June 1440, between the forces of Milan and those of the Italian League led by the Republic of Florence in the course of the Wars in Lombardy. The battle was a victory for the Florentines, securing Florentine domination of central Italy. The battle is well known for its depiction in a now-lost painting by Leonardo da Vinci. It is also remarkable for the fact that though the battle lasted all day, involving several thousand troops, it was said that only one soldier was killed.

zh.s: 安吉亚里之战于1440年6月29日爆发，交战双方是米兰军队与由佛罗伦萨共和国率领的意大利联盟军队，属于伦巴第战争的一部分。佛罗伦萨方面获胜，巩固了其对意大利中部的统治。这场战役因列奥纳多·达·芬奇一幅现已失传的画作而闻名。另一个特别之处是，尽管战斗持续了一整天，参战人数达数千，据称仅有一名士兵阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Torvioll, also known as the Battle of Lower Dibra, was fought on 29 June 1444 on the Plain of Torvioll, in what is modern-day Albania. Skanderbeg was an Ottoman Albanian captain who decided to go back to his native land and take the reins of a new Albanian rebellion. He, along with 300 other Albanians fighting at the Battle of Niš, deserted the Ottoman army to head towards Krujë, which fell quickly through a subversion. He then formed the League of Lezhë, a confederation of Albanian princes united in war against the Ottoman Empire.

zh.s: 托尔维奥尔之战又称下迪布拉之战，于1444年6月29日在托尔维奥尔平原爆发，地点在今天的阿尔巴尼亚境内。斯坎德培曾是奥斯曼帝国的阿尔巴尼亚裔军官，后来决定返回故乡，领导新的阿尔巴尼亚起义。他与另外300名参加尼什之战的阿尔巴尼亚人一起脱离奥斯曼军队，前往克鲁亚；他们通过策反，很快控制了这座城镇。之后，他组建了莱什联盟，联合阿尔巴尼亚诸侯对抗奥斯曼帝国。

en.s: The Battle of Wolfenbüttel took place on 29 June 1641 during the Thirty Years' War outside Wolfenbüttel, Lower Saxony. A Swedish army supported by its German allies was besieging the town, and defeated an attempt by Imperial forces to relieve it.

zh.s: 沃尔芬比特尔之战于1641年6月29日在三十年战争期间爆发，地点在下萨克森州沃尔芬比特尔城外。瑞典军队正在围攻该城，并有德国盟军支援；他们击退了帝国军队解围的企图。

en.s: The Battle of Cropredy Bridge was a battle of the English Civil Wars, fought on 29 June 1644 between a Parliamentarian army under Sir William Waller and the Royalist army of King Charles. After a Parliamentarian attack on the Royalist rearguard was repulsed, Waller's army became demoralised and ineffective, allowing the King to retrieve the Royalists' fortunes after other defeats during the earlier part of the year.

zh.s: 克罗普雷迪桥之战是英国内战期间的一场战斗，于1644年6月29日爆发，交战双方是威廉·沃勒爵士率领的议会军和查理国王的保王军。议会军进攻保王军后卫部队未果，随后士气低落、战斗力下降，使国王得以扭转当年早些时候几场失利带来的局面。

en.s: The Battle of Konotop or Battle of Sosnivka was fought between a coalition led by the Hetman of Ukrainian Cossacks Ivan Vyhovsky and cavalry units of the Russian Tsardom under the command of Semyon Pozharsky and Semyon Lvov, supported by Cossacks of Ivan Bezpaly, on June 29, 1659, near the town of Konotop, Ukraine, during the Russo-Polish War (1654–67). Vyhovsky's coalition, in which the Crimean Tatars of Mehmed IV Giray played a major role, defeated the Russians and their allies and forced the main Russian army to interrupt the siege of Konotop.

zh.s: 科诺托普之战又称索斯尼夫卡之战。1659年6月29日，在俄波战争（1654—1667年）期间，由乌克兰哥萨克盖特曼伊万·维霍夫斯基率领的联军，与俄罗斯沙皇国的骑兵交战。俄军由谢苗·波扎尔斯基和谢苗·利沃夫指挥，并有伊万·别兹帕雷的哥萨克部队支援。维霍夫斯基的联军中，梅赫梅德四世·格莱的克里米亚鞑靼人发挥了重要作用。联军击败俄军及其盟友，迫使俄军主力中止对科诺托普的围困。

en.s: The Battle of Polonka (Połonka) took place near Połonka (modern Belarus) during the Polish-Russian War (1658-1667) on June 29, 1660 between Polish-Lithuanian and Russian forces. Polish-Lithuanian army under Stefan Czarniecki and Paweł Jan Sapieha forced a Russian retreat through a carefully planned hussar ambush and several tactically effective flanking maneuvers. The Russian defeat also meant they had to abandon the Siege of Lyakhavichy (Lachowicze).

zh.s: 波隆卡之战于1660年6月29日在波隆卡附近爆发（今属白俄罗斯），是波兰—俄罗斯战争（1658—1667年）的一场战斗。交战双方是波兰—立陶宛联邦军队和俄军。斯特凡·恰尔涅茨基与帕维尔·扬·萨皮耶哈率领的波军通过精心策划的翼骑兵伏击和几次有效的侧翼机动，迫使俄军撤退。俄军战败后，也不得不放弃对利亚霍维奇的围攻。

en.s: The Battle of Texel was a sea battle fought during the Nine Years' War on 29 June 1694, when a force of 7 French ships, under Jean Bart, recaptured a French convoy, which had earlier that month been taken by the Dutch, and captured 3 ships of the 8-ship escorting force under Hidde de Vries. De Vries was captured by the French, but shortly after died of wounds.

zh.s: 九年战争期间，1694年6月29日爆发泰瑟尔海战。让·巴尔率领7艘法国船只，夺回了当月早些时候被荷兰人截获的一支法国船队，并俘获了希德·德弗里斯率领的8艘护航船中的3艘。德弗里斯被法军俘虏，不久后因伤去世。

en.s: The Battle of San Pietro, also known as the Battle of Crocetta or the Battle of Parma was a battle fought on June 29, 1734, between troops of France and Sardinia on one side, and Habsburg Austrian troops on the other, as part of the War of Polish Succession, between the village of La Crocetta and the city of Parma, then in the Duchy of Parma. Austrian troops assaulted an entrenched Franco-Sardinian position, and were ultimately repulsed, due in part to the death of their commander, Florimund Mercy, and the wounding of his second in command, Frederick of Württemberg.

zh.s: 圣彼得罗之战又称克罗切塔之战或帕尔马之战，于1734年6月29日爆发，是波兰王位继承战争的一部分。交战双方一边是法国和撒丁岛军队，另一边是哈布斯堡奥地利军队，战场位于当时帕尔马公国境内的克罗切塔村与帕尔马城之间。奥军进攻法撒联军的坚固阵地，最终被击退；其指挥官弗洛里蒙·梅西阵亡，副手符腾堡的腓特烈受伤，也是奥军失利的原因之一。

en.s: The siege of Fort St Philip, also known as the siege of Minorca, took place from 20 April to 29 June 1756 during the Seven Years' War. Ceded to Great Britain in 1714 by Spain following the War of the Spanish Succession, its capture by France threatened the British naval position in the Western Mediterranean and it was returned after the Treaty of Paris (1763).

zh.s: 七年战争期间，1756年4月20日至6月29日，法军围攻圣菲利普堡，又称梅诺卡围城战。西班牙在西班牙王位继承战争后于1714年将梅诺卡割让给英国。该堡被法国攻占后，英国在西地中海的海军地位受到威胁；根据《巴黎条约》，梅诺卡于1763年归还英国。

en.s: On June 29, 1764, an extremely violent IF5 tornado struck the town of Woldegk, Holy Roman Empire (modern day Germany.) The tornado received the unique T11 rating on the TORRO scale along with an F5 rating on the Fujita scale and had winds estimated to be at least 480 kilometres per hour (300 mph). The tornado traveled 30 kilometres (19 mi) and reached a maximum width of 900 metres (980 yd).

zh.s: 1764年6月29日，一场极强的IF5级龙卷风袭击神圣罗马帝国的沃尔德格克（今德国）。这场龙卷风在托罗尺度上获得罕见的T11评级，在藤田尺度上为F5级，估计风速至少达到每小时480公里（每小时300英里）。龙卷风行进了30公里（19英里），最大宽度达900米（980码）。

en.s: The siege of Silistra was a military siege undertaken by Russia between 18 and 29 June 1773 against the Ottoman city of Silistria. The siege was an important phase of the Russo-Turkish War (1768–1774), and resulted in an Ottoman victory.

zh.s: 1773年6月18日至29日，俄军围攻奥斯曼帝国城市锡利斯特拉。这次围城是俄土战争（1768—1774年）的重要阶段，最终奥斯曼帝国获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Turtle Gut Inlet (June 29, 1776) was an important, early naval victory for the Continental Navy and the future "Father of the American Navy", Captain John Barry.It was the first privateer battle of the American Revolutionary War.The battle resulted in the first American casualty of the war in New Jersey, Lieutenant Richard Wickes, brother of Captain Lambert Wickes.It was the only Revolutionary War battle fought in Cape May County.

zh.s: 龟湾之战发生于1776年6月29日，是大陆海军早期的一场重要海战胜利；后来被称为“美国海军之父”的约翰·巴里上尉参与其中。这是美国独立战争期间的首次私掠船战斗。此战造成新泽西州在战争中的首名美国人阵亡者理查德·威克斯中尉——他是兰伯特·威克斯上尉的兄弟。这也是独立战争期间唯一一场发生在梅角县的战斗。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Virginia on June 29, 1776. The delegate from Hanover County Patrick Henry defeated Thomas Nelson Jr. and John Page. The election took place forty-five days after the adoption of the Lee Resolution by the Fifth Virginia Convention declaring the independence of the United Colonies from Great Britain. The Constitution of Virginia had been adopted by the convention the same day and went into effect immediately.

zh.s: 1776年6月29日，弗吉尼亚州举行州长选举。汉诺威县代表帕特里克·亨利击败托马斯·纳尔逊二世和约翰·佩奇。此次选举在第五届弗吉尼亚大会通过《李氏决议》、宣布联合殖民地脱离英国独立45天后举行。《弗吉尼亚宪法》也于同一天由大会通过，并立即生效。

en.s: The Battle of Nantes was a battle between Royalist and Republican French forces at Nantes on 29 June 1793 during the War in the Vendée. It consisted of the siege of that town, and was a Republican victory.

zh.s: 1793年6月29日，旺代战争期间，保王派法军与共和派法军在南特交战。这场战斗包括对该城的围攻，最终共和派获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Nimla took place on 29 June 1809, due to a conflict between Mahmud Shah Durrani and Shah Shuja Durrani over the succession for the Afghan Durrani throne. The battle resulted in a victory for Mahmud Shah and allowed him to secure the throne, where he reigned from 1809 to 1818. This was his second reign before he was deposed.

zh.s: 1809年6月29日，马哈茂德·沙阿·杜兰尼与沙阿·舒贾·杜兰尼因阿富汗杜兰尼王朝王位继承问题交战，爆发尼姆拉之战。马哈茂德获胜并保住王位，统治至1818年；这是他第二次登基，之后他被废黜。

en.s: In the siege of Tarragona, from 5 May to 29 June 1811, Louis Gabriel Suchet's French Army of Aragon laid siege to a Spanish garrison led by Lieutenant General Juan Senen de Contreras. A British naval squadron commanded by Admiral Edward Codrington harassed the French besiegers with cannon fire and transported large numbers of reinforcements into the city by sea.

zh.s: 1811年5月5日至6月29日，路易·加布里埃尔·絮歇率领的法国阿拉贡军团围攻塔拉戈纳，城内由胡安·塞南·德·孔特雷拉斯中将率领的西班牙守军驻守。爱德华·科德林顿海军上将指挥的英国舰队以炮火袭扰法军围城部队，并通过海路向城内运送大量增援。

en.s: The Battle of La Victoria occurred on 20 and 29 June 1812, in La Victoria, Venezuela. Both Spanish assaults on the city by captain Domingo de Monteverde against the forces of Francisco de Miranda were repulsed by the Venezuelan forces entrenched in the city and Monterverde fell back to San Mateo. Developments in Puerto Cabello, where the Spanish prisoners of war held there took control of the castle and a slave rebellion near Caracas convinced Miranda that it would do more harm than good to continue the resistance.

zh.s: 拉维多利亚之战发生于1812年6月20日和29日，地点在委内瑞拉拉维多利亚。多明戈·德·蒙特韦德上尉率领西班牙军队两次进攻该城，均被弗朗西斯科·德·米兰达的委内瑞拉军队击退；蒙特韦德随后撤回圣马特奥。波多贝略发生的事态——当地被关押的西班牙战俘控制了城堡——以及加拉加斯附近的一场奴隶起义，让米兰达认为继续抵抗弊大于利。

en.s: The Battle of La Cuchilla de El Tambo was fought during the Colombian War of Independence, fought between the Republican troops of New Granada and the expeditionary force of the Spanish crown who came to reconquer its former colony. It took place on 29 June 1816, at a place called La cuchilla del Tambo (the ridge of El Tambo), in the vicinity of the town of Popayán (in the south of the present-day Colombia).

zh.s: 坦博山脊之战是哥伦比亚独立战争的一场战斗，交战双方是新格拉纳达共和军和西班牙王室派出的远征军，后者试图收复这片前殖民地。战斗于1816年6月29日在坦博山脊爆发，地点靠近波帕扬镇，位于今哥伦比亚南部。

en.s: The Battle of Sculeni was fought on 29 June 1821 in Sculeni, Moldavia between the Ottoman forces of Sultan Mahmud II and Greek Filiki Eteria forces led by Prince George Catakouzenos. It came as a result of Ottoman reprisals for Alexander Ypsilantis' expedition in the two Danubian Principalities, and followed in the aftermath of the Battle of Dragashani (as a prelude to the Greek War of Independence). When the Ottomans crossed the Bahlui River in Iaşi on 25 June 1821, Lieutenant Catakouzenos and his forces, originally stationed on the Russian frontier, crossed the Prut River.

zh.s: 斯库莱尼之战于1821年6月29日在摩尔达维亚的斯库莱尼爆发，交战双方是马哈茂德二世苏丹麾下的奥斯曼军队和由乔治·卡塔库泽诺亲王率领的希腊友爱社部队。此战是奥斯曼帝国对亚历山大·伊普西兰蒂斯远征两个多瑙河公国的报复行动之一，发生在德拉加沙尼之战之后，也为希腊独立战争拉开序幕。1821年6月25日，奥斯曼军队渡过雅西的巴赫卢伊河时，原驻扎在俄罗斯边境的卡塔库泽诺中尉及其部队渡过普鲁特河。

en.s: The Sinsinawa Mound raid occurred on June 29, 1832, near the Sinsinawa mining settlement in Michigan Territory (present-day Grant County, Wisconsin in the United States). This incident, part of the Black Hawk War, resulted in the deaths of two men; a third man survived by seeking cover in a nearby blockhouse. In the aftermath of the raid, Captain James W. Stephenson set out to pursue the attackers—a straggling band of Sauk Native Americans—but lost their trail at the Mississippi River. The attack occurred in the same week as other skirmishes and raids, and as a result helped contribute to the growing fear in the region.

zh.s: 1832年6月29日，辛西纳瓦丘陵突袭发生在密歇根领地的辛西纳瓦矿业聚居点附近（今美国威斯康星州格兰特县）。这起事件是黑鹰战争的一部分，造成两名男子死亡；第三人躲进附近的碉堡，得以幸存。突袭后，詹姆斯·W·史蒂芬森上尉出发追击一小队落单的索克族人，但在密西西比河畔失去了他们的踪迹。这次袭击发生在同一周的其他几场冲突和突袭期间，也加剧了当地居民日益增长的恐惧。

en.s: The Battle of Ayshal was fought on 29 June 1853, between the forces of Kassa Hailu and the forces of Ras Ali II, in Ayshal, in eastern Gojjam. Kassa's forces won the battle. The popularity of Kassa continued to grow as he defeated several nobles one after another, including Dejazmach Birru Goshu, Birru Aligaz and Belew. Birru Aligaz and Belew were defeated in the battle of Taqussa, that enraged Ras Ali.

zh.s: 阿伊沙勒之战于1853年6月29日在戈贾姆东部的阿伊沙勒爆发，交战双方是卡萨·海卢和拉斯·阿里二世的部队。卡萨获胜。随着卡萨接连击败多位贵族——包括德贾兹马奇·比鲁·戈舒、比鲁·阿利加兹和贝卢——他的声望继续上升。比鲁·阿利加兹和贝卢在塔库萨之战中被击败，拉斯·阿里对此十分恼怒。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The First Battle of Rivas occurred on June 29, 1855, as part of the struggle to resist William Walker, an American filibuster, adventurer and soldier of fortune who arrived in Nicaragua with a small army of mercenaries in June 1855 in support of the Liberal democratic government of General Castellon in the Nicaraguan civil war. His army, with local support, was able to defeat the Legitimist party (Aristocratic) and conclude the Nicaraguan civil war.

zh.s: 里瓦斯第一次战役于1855年6月29日爆发，是反抗美国冒险家、雇佣兵威廉·沃克的斗争的一部分。1855年6月，沃克率领一支小规模雇佣兵队伍来到尼加拉瓜，支持内战中的卡斯特利翁将军领导的自由派民主政府。沃克的部队在当地人支持下击败了正统派（贵族派），结束了尼加拉瓜内战。

en.s: The Battle of Savage's Station took place on June 29, 1862, in Henrico County, Virginia, as fourth of the Seven Days Battles (Peninsula Campaign) of the American Civil War. The main body of the Union Army of the Potomac began a general withdrawal toward the James River. Confederate Brig. Gen. John B. Magruder pursued along the railroad and the Williamsburg Road and struck Maj. Gen. Edwin Vose Sumner's II Corps (the Union rearguard) with three brigades near Savage's Station, while Maj. Gen. Thomas J. "Stonewall" Jackson's divisions were stalled north of the Chickahominy River.

zh.s: 萨维奇车站之战于1862年6月29日在弗吉尼亚州亨里科县爆发，是美国内战半岛战役中七日战役的第四场战斗。波托马克联邦军主力开始全面撤往詹姆斯河。南军准将约翰·B·马格鲁德沿铁路和威廉斯堡公路追击，并在萨维奇车站附近率三支旅袭击了联邦军后卫部队——埃德温·沃斯·萨姆纳少将的第二军。与此同时，托马斯·J·“石墙”杰克逊少将的部队仍被阻在奇克霍米尼河北岸。

en.t: Confederate forces capture a Union position near Goodrich’s Landing
en.s: On June 29, 1863, Confederate troops led by William H. Parsons approached a fortified Union position near Goodrich’s Landing, Louisiana, and secured its surrender. Fighting in the area continued the next day during the Vicksburg campaign.
en.n: This records the first day of the June 29–30 fighting.

zh.t: 南军夺取古德里奇登陆点附近的北军据点
zh.s: 1863年6月29日，威廉·H·帕森斯率领南军逼近美国路易斯安那州古德里奇登陆点附近的北军防御据点，迫使守军投降。当地战斗是维克斯堡战役的一部分，并持续到次日。
zh.n: 此条记录为6月29日至30日战斗的第一天。

loc: 美国弗吉尼亚州丁威迪县

en.s: The First Battle of Ream's Station was fought on June 29, 1864, during the Wilson-Kautz Raid of the American Civil War. Confederate forces under Maj. Gen. William Mahone and Brig. Gen. Fitzhugh Lee defeated Union cavalry raiding Confederate railroads south of Petersburg, Virginia.

zh.s: 雷姆车站第一次战役于1864年6月29日爆发，是美国内战威尔逊—考茨突袭行动的一部分。马洪少将和菲茨休·李准将率领的南军击败了联邦骑兵；这些骑兵当时正在弗吉尼亚州彼得斯堡以南袭击南军铁路。

en.s: The Belœil train disaster occurred on June 29, 1864, at the present-day town of Belœil, Quebec. A passenger train fell through an open swing bridge into the Richelieu River after the crew failed to obey a stop signal. The widely accepted death toll is 99 people. The disaster remains the worst railway accident in Canadian history.

zh.s: 1864年6月29日，贝洛伊尔列车事故发生在今加拿大魁北克省贝洛伊尔镇。一列客运火车因工作人员没有遵守停车信号，驶入已开启的旋转桥缺口，坠入黎塞留河。普遍认可的死亡人数为99人。这是加拿大历史上最严重的铁路事故。

en.s: The Battle of Gitschin or Jičín (German: Schlacht bei Gitschin) was a battle of the Austro-Prussian War on 29 June 1866, ending with a Prussian victory over the Austrian forces. There is a memorial there today at Jičín in the Czech Republic.

zh.s: 吉钦之战又称伊钦之战，是普奥战争中的一场战斗，于1866年6月29日爆发，最终普军击败奥军。如今，捷克伊钦仍有一座纪念碑。

en.s: The Battle of Schweinschädel (Czech: Bitva u Svinišťan) took place during the Austro-Prussian War between Prussia and Austria on 29 June 1866. The IV Army Corps of the Austrian Army under Tassilo Festetics tried to stop the advance of the Prussian 2nd Army under Crown Prince Friedrich, but was defeated by the V Army Corps under General von Steinmetz and had to withdraw.

zh.s: 施魏因舍德尔之战（捷克语：Bitva u Svinišťan）是普奥战争期间普鲁士与奥地利之间的一场战斗，于1866年6月29日爆发。塔西洛·费斯泰蒂奇指挥的奥军第四军试图阻止弗里德里希王储率领的普鲁士第二集团军推进，但被冯·施泰因梅茨将军指挥的第五军击败，被迫撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Königinhof was a battle of the Austro-Prussian War, taking place in the town of Königinhof. As one of the preliminary engagements leading up to the Battle of Königgrätz, it resulted in a victory for Prussian forces despite stiff Austrian resistance.

zh.s: 克尼金霍夫战役是普奥战争期间在克尼金霍夫镇发生的一场战斗。它是通往柯尼希格雷茨战役的前哨战之一。尽管奥军顽强抵抗，普军仍获胜。

en.s: On June 29, 1874, Charilaos Trikoupis published an anonymous article, “Who’s to Blame?”, in the Athens newspaper Kairoi. He criticized the Crown’s appointment of minority governments.
en.n: Date given in the Julian calendar.

zh.t: 特里库皮斯发表《谁该负责？》
zh.s: 1874年6月29日，查里劳斯·特里库皮斯在雅典报纸《凯洛伊》匿名发表《谁该负责？》，批评王室任命少数派政府的做法。
zh.n: 日期采用儒略历。

en.t: Pōmare V cedes the territories of the Tahitian protectorate to France
en.s: On June 29, 1880, Tahiti’s last king, Pōmare V, ceded the protectorate’s territories to France in exchange for life annuities and the retention of royal symbols.

zh.t: 波马雷五世将塔希提等领土割让给法国
zh.s: 1880年6月29日，塔希提末代国王波马雷五世将保护地领土割让给法国，条件包括领取终身年金并保留王室象征。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Portugal on 29 June 1884. The result was a victory for the Regeneration Party, which won 110 seats.

zh.s: 1884年6月29日，葡萄牙举行议会选举。再生党获胜，赢得110个席位。

en.t: Hyde Park and several other Illinois townships voted to be annexed by Chicago, forming the largest city by area in the United States and the second-largest by population
en.s: Hyde Park Township is a former civil township in Cook County, Illinois, United States that existed as a separate municipality from 1861 until 1889 when it was annexed into the city of Chicago. Its borders are Pershing Road (formerly 39th Street) on the north, State Street on the west, Lake Michigan and the Indiana state line on the east, and 138th Street and the Calumet River on the south.

zh.t: 海德公园等伊利诺伊州多个镇区投票并入芝加哥
zh.s: 1889年6月29日，海德公园等伊利诺伊州镇区投票并入芝加哥，使芝加哥成为当时美国面积最大、人口第二多的城市。海德公园镇区位于库克县，1861年至1889年间是独立自治体。其边界为北侧的珀欣路（原39街）、西侧的州街、东侧的密歇根湖和印第安纳州州界，以及南侧的138街和卡柳梅特河。

en.s: The 1905 Finsbury East by-election was a Parliamentary by-election held on 29 June 1905. The constituency returned one Member of Parliament (MP) to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, elected by the first past the post voting system.

zh.s: 1905年6月29日，英国议会芬斯伯里东选区举行补选，选出一名下议院议员。选举采用简单多数制。

en.t: Bulgarian attacks open the Second Balkan War
en.s: On the night of June 29–30, 1913, Bulgarian forces attacked Serbian and Greek positions, opening the Second Balkan War. The attack followed disputes over the division of Macedonia after the First Balkan War.
en.n: Gregorian dates; June 29 corresponds to June 16 in the Julian calendar.

zh.t: 保加利亚发动进攻，第二次巴尔干战争爆发
zh.s: 1913年6月29日至30日夜间，保加利亚军队向塞尔维亚和希腊军队的阵地发动进攻，第二次巴尔干战争由此爆发。此前，各方因第一次巴尔干战争后马其顿领土的分配产生争端。
zh.n: 日期采用公历；公历6月29日对应当时儒略历的6月16日。

en.s: The Ontario general election, 1914 was the 14th general election held in the Province of Ontario, Canada. It was held on June 29, 1914, to elect the 111 Members of the 14th Legislative Assembly of Ontario (MLAs). The Ontario Conservative Party, led by Sir James P. Whitney, won a fourth consecutive term in government. Whitney died three months after the election and was succeeded by William Howard Hearst. The Ontario Liberal Party, led by Newton Wesley Rowell, formed the official opposition. Independent Labour MLA Allan Studholme was re-elected in Hamilton East. He had held the seat since a 1906 by-election.

zh.s: 1914年6月29日，安大略省举行第14届大选，选出加拿大安大略省第14届立法议会的111名议员。詹姆斯·P·惠特尼爵士领导的安大略保守党连续第四次执政。惠特尼在选举三个月后去世，由威廉·霍华德·赫斯特接任省长。纽顿·韦斯利·罗厄尔领导的安大略自由党成为官方反对党。独立劳工议员艾伦·斯塔德霍姆在汉密尔顿东选区再次当选；他自1906年补选以来一直代表该选区。

en.s: The Battle of Ngaundere or Battle of Ngaoundéré was a small engagement fought between German and British forces on 29 June 1915 during the Kamerun campaign of World War I. It resulted in a German defeat and British occupation of the town.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战喀麦隆战役期间，1915年6月29日，德英两军在恩冈代雷发生小规模交战。德军战败，英军占领该镇。

en.s: The North Saskatchewan River flood of 1915 was one of the largest floods in the history of Edmonton. On 28 June, the Edmonton Bulletin reported the river had risen "10 feet [3.0 m] in as many hours." A frantic telegram from Rocky Mountain House alerted local authorities to the flood's arrival. The water rose to the deck level of the Low Level Bridge and debris was gathered along the bridge.
en.n: The North Saskatchewan River flood of 1915 is the worst flood in Edmonton history.

zh.s: 1915年北萨斯喀彻温河洪水是埃德蒙顿历史上规模最大的洪水之一。6月28日，《埃德蒙顿公报》报道，河水“在10小时内上涨了10英尺（3米）”。落基山庄发来的紧急电报提醒当地政府洪水即将到来。河水涨至低层桥桥面高度，桥边堆满了漂流物。
zh.n: 北萨斯喀彻温河洪水是埃德蒙顿历史上最严重的一次洪水。

en.s: The Hakkari expedition of 1916 (21 May–29 June 1916) was a number of raids during World War I conducted by the Assyrian volunteers against local Hakkari Kurdish tribesmen who the year prior, with the help of the Ottoman Empire, expelled the Assyrians from Hakkari, resulting in their settling in Russian-controlled Urmia and its surroundings.

zh.s: 1916年5月21日至6月29日，第一次世界大战期间，亚述志愿军对当地哈卡里库尔德部族发动多次袭击。此前一年，这些部族在奥斯曼帝国帮助下将亚述人逐出哈卡里，迫使他们迁居俄罗斯控制下的乌尔米耶及周边地区。

en.s: The Sochi conflict was a three-party armed conflict which involved the counterrevolutionary White Russian forces, Bolshevik Red Army and the Democratic Republic of Georgia, each of which sought control over the strategic Black Sea town of Sochi. The conflict was fought as a part of the Russian Civil War and lasted with varying success from June 1918 to May 1919, and ended through British mediation.

zh.s: 索契冲突是俄罗斯白军、布尔什维克红军和格鲁吉亚民主共和国之间的三方武装冲突，各方都试图控制具有战略意义的黑海城市索契。冲突是俄国内战的一部分，从1918年6月持续到1919年5月，期间战况反复，最终由英国出面调停。

en.s: The 1919 Inter-Allied Games football final was a football match to determine the winners of the football tournament of the Inter-Allied Games, a one-off multi-sport event held to celebrate the end of the First World War. The match took place in the newly constructed Pershing Stadium just outside Paris, on 29 June 1919, and it was contested by Czechoslovakia and the France, and ended in a 3–2 win to the former.

zh.s: 1919年协约国运动会足球决赛旨在决出这届一次性综合运动会足球赛事的冠军；运动会为庆祝第一次世界大战结束而举办。比赛于1919年6月29日在巴黎郊外新建的潘兴体育场举行，由捷克斯洛伐克对阵法国，最终前者以3比2获胜。

en.s: The 1920 Manitoba general election was held on June 29, 1920 to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of the Province of Manitoba, Canada. This was the first election since the Winnipeg General Strike, which had violently divided the people of Winnipeg, Manitoba's capital and largest city, into two camps.

zh.s: 1920年6月29日，加拿大马尼托巴省举行大选，选出该省立法议会议员。这是温尼伯总罢工后的首次选举。那场罢工激烈分化了马尼托巴省首府、最大城市温尼伯的居民。

en.s: The Copa del Generalísimo 1941 final was the 39th final of the King's Cup. The final was played at Estadio Chamartín in Madrid, on 29 June 1941, being won by Valencia, who beat RCD Espanyol 3-1.

en.s: The defense of Brest Fortress was the first battle of Operation Barbarossa, the Axis invasion of the Soviet Union launched on 22 June 1941. The German Army attacked without warning, expecting to take Brest on the first day, using only infantry and artillery, but it took them a week, and only after two bombardments by the Luftwaffe. Many defenders were killed or captured.

zh.s: 布列斯特要塞保卫战是巴巴罗萨行动（轴心国于1941年6月22日发动的入侵苏联行动）的第一场战斗。德军发动突然袭击，原以为只靠步兵和炮兵、一天内就能攻下布列斯特，但战斗持续了一周，德军还进行了两次空军轰炸后才攻下要塞。许多守军阵亡或被俘。

en.s: The Battle of Mersa Matruh was fought from 26 to 29 June 1942, following the defeat of the Eighth Army (General Sir Claude Auchinleck) at the Battle of Gazala and was part of the Western Desert Campaign of the Second World War. en.s: The Polotsk offensive (Russian: Полоцкая наступательная операция) was part of the second phase of the Belorussian strategic offensive of the Red Army in summer 1944, commonly known as Operation Bagration. The Soviet First Baltic Front successfully pursued the retreating remnants of the German Third Panzer Army back towards Polotsk, which was reached by 1 July.

zh.s: 波洛茨克攻势是红军1944年夏季白俄罗斯战略进攻第二阶段的一部分，通常称为“巴格拉季昂行动”。苏联第一波罗的海方面军追击撤退的德国第三装甲集团军残部，成功将其逼回波洛茨克方向，并于7月1日抵达该城。

en.t: United States v England (1950 FIFA World Cup)
en.s: The United States men's soccer team defeated England 1–0 on 29 June 1950, in a group match of the 1950 FIFA World Cup at Estádio Independência in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. The result is notable as one of the biggest shocks in the tournament's history. Before the game, England were heavy favorites against a hastily assembled U.S. team, which was composed of part-time players. The game's only goal was scored by the U.S.'s Haitian-born centre forward Joe Gaetjens. This game and the U.S. team were profiled by author Geoffrey Douglas in his book The Game of Their Lives, which was made into a film of the same name (later renamed The Miracle Match).

zh.t: 1950年世界杯美国对英格兰之战
zh.s: 1950年6月29日，在巴西贝洛奥里藏特的独立体育场举行的1950年国际足联世界杯小组赛中，美国男足以1比0击败英格兰。这场比赛被视为赛事历史上最大的冷门之一。赛前，英格兰队被普遍看好，美国队则是仓促组建的队伍，球员都是兼职球员。比赛唯一进球由海地裔美国中锋乔·盖特延斯打进。这场比赛及美国队的故事被作家杰弗里·道格拉斯写进《他们的比赛》一书，后来被改编成同名电影（后改名《奇迹之战》）。

The festival returned to its no official prizes standard this year; however, the attending international critics decided to vote anyways and declared When Willie Comes Marching Home by John Ford the best picture of the festival.

en.s: The Manhattan Rebellion was a failed coup attempt by officers of the Royal Thai Navy against the government of Prime Minister Plaek Pibulsonggram (Phibun) on 29–30 June 1951. The Manhattan left Philadelphia on 4/4/51 under the command of U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Captain Kelly O'Neal. He and 16 crew members delivered the vessel to the Kong Toi docks at the King's Royal Palace for the transfer ceremony. A group of junior naval officers seized Phibun at gunpoint while he was attending the transfer ceremony of the US Navy dredge Manhattan to the Thai navy at Ratchaworadit Pier on the Chao Phraya River in Bangkok.

zh.s: 曼哈顿叛乱是泰国皇家海军军官于1951年6月29日至30日发动的一次未遂政变，目标是推翻总理銮披汶·颂堪（披汶）的政府。美国陆军工兵部队的凯利·奥尼尔上尉指挥“曼哈顿”号，率领16名船员于1951年4月4日离开费城，将船送到泰王宫的空提码头参加移交仪式。一群海军初级军官在仪式期间持枪劫持了披汶。当时，仪式正在曼谷昭披耶河畔的拉差沃拉迪码头举行，内容是将美国海军挖泥船“曼哈顿”号移交给泰国海军。

The battle was one of the bloodiest defeats of the French Union forces, along with the battle of Dien Bien Phu shortly beforehand.

zh.s: 曼阳山口之战又称安溪之战或达克波之战，是第一次印度支那战争末期法国联盟与越盟之间的战斗，发生于1954年6月24日至29日。这是法国联盟军队遭遇的最惨重失败之一，此前不久的奠边府之战也造成了惨败。

en.s: The 1955 Alberta general election was held on June 29, 1955, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of Alberta. Despite losing almost 10% of the popular vote (compared to its 1952 proportion of the vote) and 30% of its seats in the legislature, the Social Credit Party, led by Ernest C. Manning, received a slightly higher number of votes than in 1952 and won a comfortable majority for its sixth term in government.

zh.s: 1955年6月29日，阿尔伯塔省举行大选，选出该省立法议会议员。欧内斯特·C·曼宁领导的社会信用党虽然得票率比1952年减少近10个百分点、席位减少30%，但得票总数略有增加，并以明显优势赢得多数席位，连续第六次执政。

en.s: The Federal-Aid Highway Act of 1956, also known as the National Interstate and Defense Highways Act, Pub. L. 84–627 was enacted on June 29, 1956, when President Dwight D. Eisenhower signed the bill into law. With an original authorization of $25 billion (equivalent to $220 billion in 2025) for the construction of 41,000 miles (66,000 km) of the Interstate Highway System over a 10-year period, it was the largest public works project in American history through that time.

zh.s: 《1956年联邦援助公路法》又称《州际公路和国防公路法》，公法编号84-627。1956年6月29日，德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔总统签署该法案，使其正式生效。该法最初授权250亿美元（相当于2025年的2200亿美元），计划在10年内修建41,000英里（66,000公里）的州际公路。这是当时美国历史上规模最大的公共工程项目。

en.s: A by-election was held on 29 June 1957, with nomination day occurring on 18 May 1957 in both the constituencies of Cairnhill and Tanjong Pagar. Ultimately, Labour Front lost the Cairnhill seat to the new Liberal Socialist Party candidate Soh Ghee Soon, while Tanjong Pagar incumbent Lee Kuan Yew retained his seat. The by-election had a voter turnout of merely 43.55%, the lowest of any elections during the period between 1948 and 1959.

zh.s: 1957年6月29日，开恩山和丹戎巴葛两个选区举行补选，提名日为同年5月18日。劳工阵线在开恩山选区败给新成立的自由社会主义党候选人苏义顺；丹戎巴葛选区的在任议员李光耀则保住席位。此次补选投票率仅为43.55%，是1948至1959年间所有选举中最低的。

en.s: The 1958 FIFA World Cup final took place in Råsunda Stadium, Solna (near Stockholm), Sweden, on 29 June 1958 to determine the champion of the 1958 FIFA World Cup. Brazil won the World Cup by defeating Sweden, and thus won their first World Cup title. Despite losing, the game remains Sweden’s best ever World Cup finish.

zh.s: 1958年6月29日，1958年国际足联世界杯决赛在瑞典索尔纳的罗斯恩达球场举行（靠近斯德哥尔摩），决出本届赛事冠军。巴西击败瑞典，首次夺得世界杯冠军。尽管瑞典队落败，这仍是该队在世界杯上的最佳成绩。

en.s: The Copa del Generalísimo 1958 final was the 56th final of the King's Cup. The final was played at Estadio Chamartín in Madrid, on 29 June 1958, being won by Atlético de Bilbao, who beat Real Madrid 2–0. Although both clubs remained among the regulars competing for trophies, they did not meet in another final again until the 2021–22 Supercopa de España, almost 64 years later.

zh.s: 1958年西班牙元首杯第56场决赛于6月29日在马德里的查马丁球场举行，毕尔巴鄂竞技以2比0击败皇家马德里。两队此后仍经常争夺各项赛事冠军，但直到近64年后的2021—22赛季西班牙超级杯决赛才再次在决赛中相遇。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in South Korea on 29 June 1960. They were the first and only direct elections of the Second Republic and saw the first election of members of the new House of Councillors, together with the fifth election of members of the House of Representatives. They were also the first relatively free and fair national elections held in the country, but would be the last free elections until the 1987 presidential elections.

zh.s: 1960年6月29日，韩国举行国会选举。这是第二共和国唯一一次直接选举；新设的参议院首次产生议员，同时众议院举行第五次议员选举。这也是韩国首次相对自由、公平举行的全国选举，但此后直到1987年总统选举前，韩国都没有再举行自由选举。

en.s: In 1966, the previous Iraqi prime minister Arif Abd ar-Razzaq and other Iraqi air force and army officers attempted to overthrow the Iraqi president Abdul Rahman Arif and the prime minister of the Iraqi government Abd al-Rahman al-Bazzaz. The attempt was supported by Egyptian president Gamal Abdel Nasser, following his first failed attempt against Abdul Salam Arif in 1965.

zh.s: 1966年，伊拉克前总理阿里夫·阿卜杜勒·拉扎克和其他伊拉克空军、陆军军官试图推翻总统阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·阿里夫及政府总理阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·巴扎兹。埃及总统贾迈勒·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔支持这次政变未遂；此前他曾于1965年首次尝试推翻阿卜杜勒·萨拉姆·阿里夫，但没有成功。

en.s: Furman v. Georgia, 408 U.S. 238 (1972), was a landmark criminal case in which the United States Supreme Court decided that arbitrary and inconsistent imposition of the death penalty violates the Eighth and Fourteenth Amendments, and constitutes cruel and unusual punishment. It was a per curiam decision. Five justices each wrote separately in support of the decision.

en.s: El Tanquetazo or El Tancazo (Spanish: "The tank putsch") was an attempted coup d'état that occurred in Chile on 29 June 1973. Elements of an armored regiment of the Chilean Army led by Lieutenant Colonel Roberto Souper tried to overthrow the Popular Unity government of President Salvador Allende. Souper's regiment fired on buildings of the Chilean Government in central Santiago with tanks and small arms in which 22 people were killed.

zh.s: “坦克政变”（西班牙语：El Tanquetazo或El Tancazo）是智利于1973年6月29日发生的一次未遂政变。罗伯托·苏佩尔中校率领智利陆军一个装甲团试图推翻萨尔瓦多·阿连德总统的人民团结政府。苏佩尔的部队在圣地亚哥市中心用坦克和轻武器向政府大楼开火，造成22人死亡。

en.s: General elections were held in Malawi on 29 June 1978. As the country had become a one-party state in 1966, the Malawi Congress Party was the sole legal party at the time. However, unlike the two previous elections, in which President-for-life Hastings Banda had selected a single candidate for each constituency, in this election there were more than one nominated candidates in 47 of the 87 seats. Candidates ran unopposed in 33 of the remaining seats, and seven were left vacant as the candidates failed the English proficiency test. Of the estimated 3,000,000 registered voters, around 371,000 cast votes.

zh.s: 1978年6月29日，马拉维举行大选。该国自1966年起成为一党制国家，当时唯一合法政党是马拉维国会党。与前两次选举中终身总统海斯廷斯·班达为每个选区只指定一名候选人不同，这次选举有47个选区提名了不止一名候选人。其余选区中，33个选区的候选人自动当选，另有7个席位因候选人未通过英语能力考试而空缺。估计300万登记选民中，约37.1万人投了票。

en.s: General elections were held in Bolivia on 29 June 1980, the third in three years. As no candidate in the presidential elections received a majority of the vote, the National Congress was required to elect a President on 6 August. With Hernán Siles Zuazo of the Democratic and Popular Union the favourite to win the Congressional ballot, the process was disrupted on 17 July by the military coup led by General Luis García Meza Tejada. However, Meza was pressured to resign on 4 August 1981, resulting in General Celso Torrelio becoming President.

zh.s: 1980年6月29日，玻利维亚举行大选，这是该国三年内举行的第三次大选。总统选举中没有候选人获得过半选票，因此国会须于8月6日选出总统。民主人民联盟的埃尔南·西莱斯·苏阿索最有希望赢得国会投票，但1980年7月17日，路易斯·加西亚·梅萨·特哈达将军发动军事政变，选举程序被迫中断。梅萨于1981年8月4日被迫辞职，塞尔索·托雷利奥将军随后就任总统。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Iceland on 29 June 1980. The result was a victory for Vigdís Finnbogadóttir, who received 33.8% of the vote. She became the world's first democratically elected female President.

en.s: On June 29, 1981, Hu Yaobang was elected chairman of the Chinese Communist Party’s Central Committee at the committee’s Sixth Plenary Session in Beijing.

zh.s: 1981年6月29日，中共十一届六中全会在北京选举胡耀邦为中共中央主席。

en.t: AEK Athens wins the 1983 Greek Cup final
en.s: AEK Athens beat PAOK 2–0 in the Greek Cup final on June 29, 1983, at the Olympic Stadium in the Athens area. The match was the first Greek Cup final staged at the newly built Olympic Stadium.

zh.t: 雅典AEK赢得1983年希腊杯决赛
zh.s: 1983年6月29日，雅典AEK队在希腊雅典地区的奥林匹克体育场以2比0击败塞萨洛尼基PAOK队，赢得希腊杯决赛。这是这座新建体育场首次承办希腊杯决赛。

en.s: The final match of the 1986 FIFA World Cup, the thirteenth edition of FIFA's football competition for men's national teams, was played at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City on 29 June 1986, and was contested between Argentina and West Germany. The tournament featured host Mexico and defending champions Italy, as well as 22 other teams that emerged from the qualification phase, organized by the six FIFA confederations.

zh.s: 1986年6月29日，第13届国际足联男子国家队世界杯决赛在墨西哥城阿兹特克体育场举行，由阿根廷对阵西德。本届赛事共有24支球队参赛，除东道主墨西哥和卫冕冠军意大利外，其余22队从由国际足联六大洲际联合会组织的资格赛中晋级。

en.t: It was played in Mexico from 31 May to 29 June 1986
en.s: The 1986 FIFA World Cup was the 13th FIFA World Cup, the quadrennial football tournament for men's senior national teams. It was played in Mexico from 31 May to 29 June 1986. The tournament was the second to feature a 24-team format. Colombia had been originally chosen to host the competition by FIFA but, largely due to economic reasons, was not able to do so, and withdrew in November 1982.

zh.s: 1986年国际足联世界杯是第13届国际足联世界杯，每四年举办一次，参赛者为男子国家队。赛事于1986年5月31日至6月29日在墨西哥举行，是第二届采用24支球队赛制的世界杯。哥伦比亚原本被国际足联选为东道主，但主要因经济原因无法承办，并于1982年11月退出。

en.s: The 1989 Svenska Cupen final took place on 29 June 1989 at Råsunda in Solna. The match was contested by Allsvenskan sides Malmö FF and Djurgårdens IF. Djurgården played their first final since 1975 and their third final in total, Malmö FF played their first final since 1986 and their 16th final in total. zh.s: 1989年瑞典杯决赛于1989年6月29日在索尔纳的罗斯恩达球场举行，由瑞典足球超级联赛球队马尔默FF和佐加顿斯IF对阵。佐加顿斯自1975年以来首次进入决赛，这是该队第三次打进决赛；马尔默自1986年以来首次进入决赛，也是该队第16次进入决赛。马尔默以3比0获胜，夺得队史第14个冠军。

en.s: The 1989 Cupa României final was the 51st final of Romania's most prestigious football cup competition. en.s: Money in the Bank (2014) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by WWE. It took place on June 29, 2014 at the TD Garden in Boston, Massachusetts. It was the fifth annual Money in the Bank event. Eight matches took place at the event, with no match aired on the pre-show. The titular ladder match for the Money in the Bank contract was won by Seth Rollins. The main event was a Ladder match for the vacant WWE World Heavyweight Championship, which was won by John Cena. The event received 122,000 buys (excluding WWE Network views), down from the previous year's 199,000 buys.

zh.s: Money in the Bank（2014）是WWE制作的职业摔角付费观看赛事，于2014年6月29日在美国马萨诸塞州波士顿的TD花园举行。这是该系列第五届赛事，共有八场比赛，预演节目没有安排比赛。塞斯·罗林斯赢得了争夺Money in the Bank合约的阶梯赛。主赛也是阶梯赛，约翰·塞纳赢得空缺的WWE世界重量级冠军头衔。不计WWE Network的观看量，赛事付费购买量为12.2万次，低于上年的19.9万次。
